result_text:
I changed the `all_files.zip` export in `reports/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/reports/dataexporters/DataExporter.java` so it no longer uses fixed file names. The `reports` module compiles. I didn't run any tests or try a renamed aspect.

Each of the five scope aspects (main, test, generated, build and deployment, other) now gets its entry name from `DataExportUtils.getAspectFileListFileName(aspect, "")`. That is the same call that writes the loose `data/text/aspect_<name>.txt` files, so the zip reads back the names those files were written under.

With the default configuration the entries are unchanged, in the same order. With `buildAndDeployment` renamed, the fourth entry becomes `aspect_buildAndDeployment.txt`. The read no longer fails, so `git-history.zip` is written too whenever `git-history.txt` exists.
